name: Le Meridien Barcelona
positioning: Art-filled Le Méridien hotel on La Rambla in central Barcelona, with terrace and panoramic suites and a spa terrace overlooking the city
best_for: Travelers who want a central base on Las Ramblas
Families wanting suites for up to four

facts.text: The hotel's address is La Rambla 111, Barcelona.
The hotel is near the lively promenade Las Ramblas and some of Barcelona's most intriguing neighborhoods.
Contemporary art is found throughout the building.
Custom-made artwork and asymmetric designs run throughout the rooms and common areas.
The lobby is awash with color.
Guest rooms and suites look out over the city streets, including Las Ramblas, the hotel courtyard, or the skyline.
Rooms have Illy espresso coffee machines.
Family Suites host up to four guests, with a private king bedroom as one of two distinct areas.
Explore Spa Studio has a separate sauna and steam room, plus an open terrace with sun loungers overlooking Barcelona and Las Ramblas.
The fitness center is open 24 hours a day.
CentOnze restaurant is 111 steps from La Boqueria market.

highlights.text: The top-floor Panoramic Suite offers 360-degree panoramic views of Barcelona.
Grand Terrace Suites have a private terrace with sun loungers, an outdoor shower and a dining table.
Explore Spa Studio spans an indoor lounge and an outdoor sun deck with open city views.
Le Méridien's Unlock Art program gives guests complimentary access to galleries and institutions.
Corner Suites have a living space overlooking Las Ramblas.

considerations.text: Rooms face the city streets, the hotel courtyard or the skyline, so the view depends on the room.
WhataHotel notes the Las Ramblas location can be busy and touristy.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the central Barcelona location.

sources.title: Condé Nast Traveler: Le Méridien Barcelona
